description: Constructed teaching inputs, not an employer portfolio, forecast, or product benchmark.

history.definition: Daily maximum one-minute mean offered requests/s, no rejected or queued requests in the historical fixture. This cannot bound sub-minute bursts.

workloads.quality: p95 latency <= 200 ms and errors <= 0.1% at the stated request mix
workloads.failure_scope: one of the modeled independent groups

workloads.quality: agreed deferral and catch-up plan required
separate illustrative resource pool; do not sum with requests/s
accepted outcomes plus rate and latency constraints
30-minute rebuild deadline; 20 minutes available for compute
capacity is unresolved until service, maintenance, and recovery evidence is supplied

web.measurement_status: fixture assumption at all modeled configurations; no actual benchmark was run
web.transfer_opportunity_cost: Unpriced: batch completion is delayed; owner must approve a catch-up plan. No cash saving or free capacity is claimed.
residual_risks: downstream data capacity not validated by worker arithmetic

decision.status: constructed recommended decision, not an approval
decision.choice: Stage launch after the transfer is qualified; pursue a new independent group; preserve a delayed-supply alternative.

conditions.action: Stage the rollout at the assumed 2000 additional requests/s and keep the ability to stop expansion.
Approve a bounded deferral and catch-up plan before transferring eight workers.
Qualify transferred capacity and failure behavior before treating it as available.
Authorize the additional 640 dollars/day contingent on supply and actual commercial terms.
Accept residual exposure or change launch scope/deadline; resolve disagreement about obligations.

review_triggers: forecast or observed demand consumes the staged margin
request mix invalidates the tested rate
new supply slips beyond the transfer agreement

outcomes.interpretation: intelligence improved this forecast, while leaving 700 requests/s of modeled degraded headroom
alternative constructed outcome: rollout delayed; the same intelligence adjustment worsened the forecast
